name: expense-tracker
description: A modern expense tracking web application

scripts.dev: concurrently --names fastapi,frontend --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run fastapi" "npm run frontend"
scripts.fastapi: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && uv sync
